# Dough Intent Coverage

**Verdict.** Caught.

**Story and checked revision.** `SEED-423#read-handoff-and-admitted-landing-from-dashboard-records` at `db58264f2e667d6ea4a6eb6bcab5468480b09ae0`. This check covers the earlier admitted session in the shared-checkout journey. Its published native landing range should have no uncertainty when the other session opens after acceptance.

**Fault.** In `Distribution/src/skills/dough-story-wrap-up/scripts/trunk-closure-admitted-session.mjs:151`, pass `undefined` instead of the retained `acceptedAt` to `rangeUncertainty`. The closure then treats the acceptance time as unknown and marks the range when the later overlap note is present.

**Observation.** The maintained journey in `dashboard/backend-tests/sessions/admitted-session-shared-checkout-completion.spec.ts:88` lands the earlier launch before admitting the second launch. It checks that the overlap note exists and reads the first launch's published record from Git `main` after closure. The baseline passed. With the fault, the published first range reported the actual uncertainty value `"shared-checkout"`. The exact-range assertion immediately above still passed. The existing absence assertion at line 143 failed with expected `undefined` and received `"shared-checkout"`. The fixture and assertions were untouched.

**Restoration.** The restored source matched its saved bytes and the detached checkout matched its original clean status. The same selected journey passed after restoration. The scratch worktree was removed.

**Run conditions.** On AC, the three proof runs used `caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:backend -- dashboard/backend-tests/sessions/admitted-session-shared-checkout-completion.spec.ts --reporter=line --grep 'each admitted launch keeps its accepted comparison'`. An initial diagnostic baseline with a Git observer reached the first closed record and confirmed its retained acceptance preceded the overlap note. It timed out while the machine's one-minute load was 29.59 on 16 logical CPUs. The direct repeat removed the observer's shell startup overhead and supplied the passing baseline. The faulted runner printed the actual Git record's uncertainty value with no observer. The diagnostic timeout does not isolate the effect of the wrapper from machine contention.

**Next proof action.** No additional proof for this scenario. Retain the existing absence assertion.

- **Test runtime.** 23.38 s baseline, 23.30 s faulted, and 31.19 s restored, 77.87 s total (measured Vitest durations). The initial instrumented calibration took 42.63 s (measured).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human active-time measurement was collected.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No active-time measurement separated agent work from setup and runner waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 301759 ms (measured), from 1795769569000 to 1795769870759 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

**Wrap-up disposition.** Revision `db58264f2e667d6ea4a6eb6bcab5468480b09ae0`, Caught. Retain the existing overlap timing assertion. No follow-up proof is required for the checked scenario.
